title: Curator release selector with performance badging
creator: Maya Kline
description:
Problem: Teams onboarding new model families find it hard to choose a production version because performance tradeoffs (latency, cost, quality) are scattered across multiple views. They sometimes pin suboptimal versions or open multiple tabs to compare benchmarks. This ticket defines a curator-centric selector inside Console that surfaces a consolidated "stability & performance" badge for each candidate version and provides guided pin/unpin flows and publish controls for performance profiles.

Goal: Deliver a single-screen assisted release selector that: (1) shows curated badging (stability, p95 latency, cost estimate, regression risk), (2) lets PMs/engineers preview a pinned set (release bundle) and publish its associated performance dossier to the public model catalog, and (3) provides explicit rollback and canary quicklinks.

Scope (MVP):
- Version list with compact performance badges and a hover card showing recent evaluation highlights.
- Compare mode: pick up to 3 versions to see side-by-side tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens estimate, and recent eval pass/fail signals.
- Pin flow: create a "release bundle" (name + pinned version + rollout policy) and surface the option to "Publish performance dossier" which snapshots the performance profile and attaches it to the model entry.
- Audit metadata saved (who pinned, timestamp, linked PRs/PRD).

Out of scope for MVP: automated traffic routing changes, multi-tenant access controls beyond existing RBAC, and runtime kernel selection UI.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows performance badges (stability | cost | latency | regression risk) for all published versions in the catalog
Hover card reveals last 3 eval snapshots with a one-line summary
Compare mode allows selecting up to 3 versions and displays normalized metrics side-by-side
Pin flow creates a named release bundle and persists audit fields (creator, timestamp, linked artifacts)
Publish performance dossier creates an immutable snapshot accessible from the model's public catalog and appears in release history
Telemetry events emitted for select, compare, pin, publish, and rollback actions (events documented in Console analytics schema)
